reguloj.name: contrast-pairs-declared
reguloj.statement: Every foreground, border and focus colour token is the foreground of a KontrastParo, and every background colour token its background; tokens with the role disabled or decorative are exempt.
reguloj.kialo: Contrast must be provable per combination (Art. X): the Alirebleco check only evaluates declared KontrastParoj across all resolutions, so an undeclared text-on-background or border-on-background pairing is an unchecked accessibility risk.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: color tokens with role foreground, background or border

reguloj.name: semantic-colors-alias-palette
reguloj.statement: Semantic color tokens in core reference palette tokens instead of literal color values.
reguloj.kialo: Aspektoj and Dimensioj then change a color by overriding one palette token, and late binding carries the change to every semantic use in every combination; a literal in a semantic token would silently opt out of that and drift between combinations.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: core color tokens outside color.palette

reguloj.name: color-roles-declared
reguloj.statement: Every colour token declares its role: palette for primitives; foreground, background, border, focus, shadow, backdrop, disabled or decorative for semantic colours.
reguloj.kialo: Roles tell the contrast gate which colours must be paired and tell agents how a colour may be used; a colour without a role can be neither checked nor explained.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: color tokens in core

reguloj.name: dimensio-sets-alias-only
reguloj.statement: Sets without an aspekto condition (generic Dimensio sets) hold aliases only and only re-point tokens that are aliases in core (roles); primitives change only per Aspekto.
reguloj.kialo: Generic Dimensio sets outrank every Aspekto set, so whatever they hold reaches every brand. A literal or a re-pointed primitive there would make every Aspekto inherit a core value, which Article IV forbids; re-pointing roles lets each Aspekto keep its own values in every combination.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: sets without an aspekto condition

reguloj.name: density-affects-layout-only
reguloj.statement: The density Dimensio re-points spacing and control-size roles only; it never changes typography. viewport and density never shift the same token.
reguloj.kialo: Density is layout compactness, font size is legibility and belongs to viewport. If viewport and density shifted the same token, the result would depend on their priority order and be predictable for nobody.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: sets density/*

reguloj.name: aspekto-complete
reguloj.statement: Every Aspekto except the reference overrides every core token in its own set aspekto/<name>; identical aliases count, conjunction sets carry deltas only.
reguloj.kialo: An Aspekto is a complete assignment of the Vortaro (Article IV). If a brand could leave a token out, it would silently inherit the reference brand's value, and a forgotten token would surface at the customer instead of in validation.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: Aspekto packages

reguloj.name: disabled-exempt-from-contrast
reguloj.statement: Colour tokens with the role disabled or decorative need no KontrastParo.
reguloj.kialo: WCAG 2.x exempts inactive components (1.4.3) and decoration that carries no information (1.4.11). Forcing contrast on them would make disabled controls look actionable and dividers look like content.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: color tokens with role disabled or decorative

reguloj.name: typography-roles-composite
reguloj.statement: Every typography role is a composite whose fields are aliases: size, line height and letter spacing alias role tokens, family and weight alias primitives.
reguloj.kialo: Dimensioj then shift role tokens along the scales and never restate a composite, which would overwrite an Aspekto's weight or family; one role per text style keeps every Projekcio and every agent on the same names.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: typography.*

reguloj.name: motion-reduced-instant
reguloj.statement: Under motion=reduced every duration role is the instant step and every easing role is linear.
reguloj.kialo: People who ask their system to reduce motion must not see animated transitions; making every duration instant through the scale keeps components working without special cases and lets each Aspekto define what instant means.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: sets motion/reduced

reguloj.name: focus-ring-dual-contrast
reguloj.statement: Every focus colour is the foreground of a KontrastParo on color.background.default and of one on its gap colour color.focus.inner.
reguloj.kialo: A single ring colour cannot reach 3:1 against a white surface, a dark inverse surface and a filled primary action at the same time. The ring therefore sits on its own gap colour and must contrast with that gap and with the surface around it, as WCAG 2.4.13 describes for focus indicators.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: color tokens with role focus; data/kontrastparoj.json

reguloj.name: surface-order
reguloj.statement: In every combination of every Aspekto, the OKLCH lightness of color.background.sunken ≤ canvas ≤ default ≤ raised, in both colour schemes; transparent values are composited over color.background.default first.
reguloj.kialo: The surface hierarchy carries spatial meaning: sunken areas sit below the page and raised ones above it. A break is visible to every user and to no contrast check, so it must be checked on its own (Constitution Art. VI, finding from the ciferecigo acceptance).
reguloj.scope: vortaro: color.background.sunken, canvas, default and raised in every combination

reguloj.name: semantic-described
reguloj.statement: Every role token in core (its value is an alias, or a composite with an alias field) has a $description that states its use: not empty, no alias reference and no colour value.
reguloj.kialo: Agents read values from bare token files but not the purpose of a token; with a description per role token they choose the right token for a use, for example a destructive action. The description is input for agents, not documentation, so it must describe the use rather than repeat the value.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: role tokens in core

reguloj.name: text-hierarchy
reguloj.statement: In every combination of every Aspekto, color.text.default, color.text.subtle and color.text.muted resolve to pairwise different colours, neighbouring roles (default and subtle, subtle and muted) differ by at least 0.05 in OKLCH lightness after compositing, and their contrast against color.background.default does not rise from default to subtle to muted.
reguloj.kialo: The text roles carry a distinction of meaning. High contrast must strengthen them, not erase them, and a contrast check does not see a collapse because every collapsed role still passes. Under contrast=high the main role takes the maximum contrast the ramp offers, so subtle and muted keep their own steps. Distinct is not distinguishable; a hierarchy the eye does not see does not exist.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: color.text.default, subtle and muted in every combination

reguloj.name: state-distinct
reguloj.statement: In every combination of every Aspekto, the OKLCH lightness of color.action.<v>.hover, .pressed and .selected differs from .rest by at least 0.05, for every action role <v>; transparent values are composited over color.background.default first.
reguloj.kialo: A state that looks like the rest state gives no feedback, and a difference in hue alone disappears in greyscale and for people with a colour-vision deficiency; no contrast check sees either. The difference must be clear, not just perceptible: 0.05 is 2.5 times the typical just-noticeable difference and leaves a reserve for poor displays and colour-vision deficiency.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: color.action.<v>.hover, pressed, selected against rest in every combination

reguloj.name: one-primary-per-container
reguloj.statement: A container holds at most one butono with emphasis=high; instances without a named container count as one container. The actions of a dialogo and of an avizo are such containers (Spec 011 ②, ③).
reguloj.kialo: Two equal calls to action move the decision onto the user; one primary action makes the next step obvious, and every other action steps back as secondary or tertiary.
reguloj.scope: eroj: butono instances in a design or in code (check_usage), the actions of a dialogo and of an avizo among them

reguloj.name: destructive-not-primary-color
reguloj.statement: An action that destroys data is never a butono with emphasis=high and intent=neutral: as the main action (a confirmation dialog) it is emphasis=high with intent=danger, next to another high-emphasis action it is emphasis=medium.
reguloj.kialo: The primary colour promises the expected next step; a destructive action needs a colour that warns before it acts, and a danger fill only where the destruction is the step the user came for.
reguloj.scope: eroj: butono instances whose goal is destructive or whose label is a destructive keyword of the Skemo

reguloj.name: label-required
reguloj.statement: Every butono has a visible label or, when it shows only an icon, a label prop as its accessible name.
reguloj.kialo: A button without a name cannot be found or understood by assistive technology, and an icon alone is not understood by everyone; the name is what a screen reader announces and what voice control listens for.
reguloj.scope: eroj: butono instances; the rendered check (axe) confirms the accessible name

reguloj.name: touch-target-min
reguloj.statement: In every combination of every Aspekto, every size.control.* resolves to at least size.target.min, the minimum pointer target of WCAG 2.5.8 (24 px). A ligilo with placement inline is exempt: running text cannot carry 24 px lines, and WCAG 2.5.8 excepts targets that stand in a sentence (Spec 008 A2).
reguloj.kialo: WCAG 2.5.8 (AA) requires a target of at least 24 by 24 px; smaller targets fail people with tremor, with large fingers or on a moving device. The threshold is a token, so the rule and the rendered component read the same value. The exception for inline links is WCAG's own: a target in a block of text is excluded from the minimum, because the line height of the text decides its size.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: size.control.* against size.target.min in every combination

reguloj.name: contrast-reserve
reguloj.statement: In every combination of every Aspekto, every KontrastParo exceeds the WCAG 2.x threshold that binds it by at least the sojlo; the branch that carries the result is the one measured.
reguloj.kialo: Meeting a threshold exactly means missing it on the next screen: font smoothing, a cheap panel, a translucent edge or a rounded value all cost a few percent. A reserve makes the promise hold outside the calculation, and it is the difference between a value that passes a test and a value that works.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: every KontrastParo in every combination

reguloj.name: surface-distinct
reguloj.statement: In every combination of every Aspekto, neighbouring surface roles (sunken, canvas, default, raised) differ in OKLCH lightness by at least the sojlo.
reguloj.kialo: If two surfaces share a lightness, only the shadow carries the layering — and the shadow is gone in high contrast, in forced colours, in print and on a screenshot. A layer that exists in the model must be visible in the value, not only in an effect.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: color.background.sunken, canvas, default, raised in every combination

reguloj.name: palette-even
reguloj.statement: In every combination of every Aspekto, a palette ramp falls strictly in OKLCH lightness, and no inner step differs from the median step of its ramp by more than the sojlo. Steps are measured as the rate per 100 step units, not as the raw distance. The first and the last step of a ramp, the anchors (pure white, pure black) and alpha ramps are out.
reguloj.kialo: A ramp is a tool: whoever says 'one step darker' must get the same effect in the middle of every ramp. Measured per 100 step units, because a ramp may number its steps unevenly (50, 100, 200, 300, 600) and still progress evenly; the raw distance would call such a ramp irregular although its rate is constant. How fine a brand grades the ends is its own business — near white the eye needs smaller steps and at the dark end a half step is common — but a jump in the middle makes the ramp unusable and shows up as a band in every gradient built from it.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: color.palette.<ramp>.<step> in every combination

reguloj.name: palette-aligned
reguloj.statement: In every combination of every Aspekto, ramps that share a step number stay within the sojlo of each other in OKLCH lightness.
reguloj.kialo: A role picks a step number, not a colour. If step 700 is dark in one ramp and mid in another, the same role weighs differently depending on its hue, and every rule built on steps stops being portable.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: color.palette.<ramp>.<step> across ramps, in every combination

reguloj.name: srgb-gamut
reguloj.statement: Every colour token resolves to components inside 0 … 1 of its colour space, in every combination of every Aspekto.
reguloj.kialo: A component outside the gamut is clipped by the browser. The clipped colour is not the colour the contrast was computed from, so a value outside the gamut turns every measurement in this repository into a guess.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: every colour token in every combination

reguloj.name: type-scale
reguloj.statement: In every combination of every Aspekto, the ratios of neighbouring steps of font.size.scale stay within the sojlo of the median ratio of the scale.
reguloj.kialo: A scale must be predictable: a designer who moves one step up expects the same jump everywhere, and a brand that is derived from another needs a rule it can recompute. Which ratio a brand picks, and whether it rounds to whole pixels, stays its own decision.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: font.size.scale.* in every combination

reguloj.name: type-rhythm
reguloj.statement: In every combination of every Aspekto, inside a role family (display, headline, body, label, …) the line height and the letter spacing of the typography roles fall as the font size grows.
reguloj.kialo: Long lines of large type need less leading and tighter tracking to stay one block of text; leading that grows with the size tears a headline apart. Compared inside a family, because a label at 14 px is deliberately snugger than body text at 16 px: across families the measurement would judge a decision of the brand, not its rhythm. That is legibility, measurable and independent of taste.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: typography.* in every combination

reguloj.name: protected-minimum
reguloj.statement: In every combination, every protected role of every Aspekto resolves to at least the value the reference Aspekto gives it in the same combination. A brand may exceed a floor, never fall below it.
reguloj.kialo: An Aspekto may differ from the reference in every category — colour, spacing, size, motion, layout (F28). Two of those measures are not a brand decision but a floor that protects a person: the minimum pointer target of WCAG 2.5.8 and the thickness of the focus indicator that WCAG 2.4.7 asks to be visible. Both are tokens, so touch-target-min and the rendered component read the same value — and so a brand could lower the threshold that protects it and pass every check. The floor is therefore the reference Aspekto's value: it is written once, in core, and no Aspekto may undercut it.
reguloj.scope: vortaro: size.target.min and focus.ring of every Aspekto against the reference Aspekto, in every combination

reguloj.name: focus-ring-concentric
reguloj.statement: Der Fokusring ist konzentrisch zu dem, was er umschließt: Sein Radius ist der Radius des umschlossenen Teils, gewachsen um den Abstand dazu — der Abstandsrahmen um den Versatz, der Ring zusätzlich um seine Strichstärke. Jedes Ero mit einem Fokusring bindet deshalb den umschlossenen Radius, den Versatz und die Strichstärke an je ein Token über alle seine Varianten; die Projektion rechnet die Radien daraus aus und trägt keinen eigenen ein.
reguloj.kialo: Das ist eine Setzung von Fundamento, keine Naturkonstante: Es gibt Marken, die einen Ring mit eigener Rundung zeichnen, abgesetzt von der Form darunter. Fundamento zeichnet ihn konzentrisch, weil ein Ring, dessen Rundung nicht zur Form passt, als Fehler gelesen wird und nicht als Absicht — gemessen an einer Marke mit Radius 0, um die ein Ring mit Radius 8 lief (F32). Wer das ändern will, ändert diese Regulo und begründet es hier, statt still zwei Tokens ins Vortaro zu legen, die jede Marke einzeln belegen und deren Verhältnis niemand mehr prüft. Was die Regel im Modelo verlangt, prüft ihr Enforcer: Ohne je ein Token für den umschlossenen Radius, den Versatz und die Strichstärke ist kein konzentrischer Ring abzuleiten. Was sie in der Projektion verlangt, halten die Zusicherungen der Projektion fest — je Modus und auch für eine Marke, die Pillen zeichnet.
reguloj.scope: eroj: das Ero und seine Teile box, focus-ring; jede Projektion, die den Ring zeichnet

reguloj.name: spacing-owned-by-container
reguloj.statement: The space between sibling Eroj belongs to their container; an Ero carries no outer spacing.
reguloj.kialo: An Ero does not know its neighbours. If each one brought its own distance, two Eroj side by side would add up their distances, and the rhythm of a view would depend on which Ero stands where.
reguloj.scope: eroj: every Ero's instances in a design or in code (butono, ligilo, kampo, sxaltilo, markobutono, elekto, elektilo, tekstareo, dialogo, insigno, avizo, plenstato, tabelo, atributlisto, mezurilo, navigado, langetaro)

reguloj.name: full-width-in-action-bar-or-compact
reguloj.statement: A butono takes the full inline size only in a container of kind action-bar or under viewport=compact.
reguloj.kialo: A full-width button claims the whole row. It reads as the single next step, which is right at the end of a narrow view or in a bar of actions, and wrong anywhere else, where it pushes every other action out of sight.
reguloj.scope: eroj: butono instances with full-width in a design or in code (check_usage); the Uzo names the containers and Dimensio values that allow it

reguloj.name: label-names-action
reguloj.statement: The label of a butono names its action as a verb.
reguloj.kialo: A person decides from the label alone what happens on activation. A verb says it; a noun or a mood makes them guess.
reguloj.scope: eroj: butono instances with a label; checked against the keywords of the Skemo's goals, so it only warns until a better check exists (plan D-02)

reguloj.name: destructive-label-names-object
reguloj.statement: A destructive label names what it destroys.
reguloj.kialo: "Löschen" alone does not say whether the draft, the project or the account goes. Only the object makes the consequence clear before it cannot be undone.
reguloj.scope: eroj: butono instances whose goal is destructive or whose label is a destructive keyword of the Skemo; fixed, no Aspekto overrides it (Uzo content)

reguloj.name: destructive-label-not-generic
reguloj.statement: A destructive action is never labelled with a generic confirmation (OK, Ja, Yes).
reguloj.kialo: A generic word confirms whatever the person thinks they are confirming. Before a loss that cannot be undone, the label must say the loss.
reguloj.scope: eroj: butono instances whose goal is destructive or whose label is a destructive keyword of the Skemo; fixed, no Aspekto overrides it (Uzo content)

reguloj.name: link-navigates-button-acts
reguloj.statement: A ligilo moves to another view or place; a butono starts an action here. A ligilo whose label names an action (a goal of the butono: save, delete, cancel) is a violation.
reguloj.kialo: Screen readers announce a link and a button differently, the keyboard operates them differently (Enter against Enter and Space), and the way back is different: a link is left with the back command, an action is undone or not at all. A label that promises an action on a link misleads all three.
reguloj.scope: eroj: ligilo instances with a label; checked against the keywords of the instead entry action of its Uzo (check not-instead)

reguloj.name: link-not-color-only
reguloj.statement: A ligilo in running text (placement inline) differs from the text by more than colour: its underline is bound in every state. The current item of a navigado differs from its neighbours by more than colour: its underline.
reguloj.kialo: WCAG 1.4.1 (Use of Color): colour alone does not carry information. A person who does not see the hue, or reads in a mode that flattens it, must still find the link in the sentence.
reguloj.scope: eroj: the Skemo of every Ero with a part underline and a prop placement; underline.width in placement inline is bound and never none; the Skemo of a navigado binds underline.width for the current item (Spec 011 ⑤)

reguloj.name: link-label-names-destination
reguloj.statement: The label of a ligilo and every item of a navigado names the destination; here, click, more or link alone name none; the skip link (saltligilo) names where it jumps to: 'Zum Inhalt springen'.
reguloj.kialo: WCAG 2.4.4 (Link Purpose in Context): a screen reader user reads the links of a page as a list, out of context; a list of here says nothing.
reguloj.scope: eroj: ligilo instances with a label and navigado instances with their items (slot items, Spec 011 ⑤) (check not-words), an approximation without a model: not-words hits every occurrence of a listed word, so a label that names the destination and carries the word as well ('Mehr zum Datenschutz') is reported too (Abnahme Spec 008 A10, R-1; candidate not-only-words in the Vojmapo, Phase 6); saltligilo instances (Spec 014 ②, E5), the one text of the label

reguloj.name: external-link-marked
reguloj.statement: A ligilo with external true marks the leaving of the application visibly and audibly: its Skemo carries an a11y text for external in de and en, and a decorative slot icon-end the projections fill with the mark.
reguloj.kialo: Leaving the application is a moment of trust; the person decides before, not after. No brand switches the mark off; only its look comes from the Aspekto.
reguloj.scope: eroj: the Skemo of every Ero with a boolean prop external

reguloj.name: link-label-not-url
reguloj.statement: The label of a ligilo is words, not an address (no http, https or www).
reguloj.kialo: An address is hard to read and to hear for a person; technical documentation may show one, with a Jugxo of the brand.
reguloj.scope: eroj: ligilo instances with a label (check not-words); adjustable by an Aspekto with a Jugxo

reguloj.name: field-label-visible
reguloj.statement: A kampo, a sxaltilo, a markobutono, an elekto, an elektilo or a tekstareo always has a visible label; an empty label slot is a violation.
reguloj.kialo: WCAG 3.3.2 (Labels or Instructions): a placeholder disappears while typing, and a label only a screen reader hears does not help the sighted person who finds the field half filled.
reguloj.scope: eroj: kampo, sxaltilo, markobutono, elekto, elektilo and tekstareo instances; the label slot has text

reguloj.name: placeholder-not-label
reguloj.statement: The placeholder of a kampo, an elektilo or a tekstareo is not the label: a placeholder without a label is a violation, a placeholder equal to the label a warning.
reguloj.kialo: A placeholder disappears while typing (WCAG 3.3.2), and an example that repeats the label says nothing.
reguloj.scope: eroj: kampo and elektilo instances with a placeholder

reguloj.name: error-says-what-to-do
reguloj.statement: The error text of a kampo, a markobutono, an elekto, an elektilo or a tekstareo, and the message of an avizo with intent danger, says what to do, not only that something is wrong.
reguloj.kialo: WCAG 3.3.3 (Error Suggestion): 'Invalid' leaves the person guessing; a sentence with a verb and an object names the way out.
reguloj.scope: eroj: kampo, markobutono, elekto, elektilo and tekstareo instances with an error text and avizo instances with intent danger (their message, Spec 011 ③); checked as at least three words (check min-words), an approximation without a model: min-words only counts the words, so a three-word text without a way out ('Das ist ungültig') passes (Abnahme Spec 009 A6, R-2; candidate for a better check in the Vojmapo, Phase 6)

reguloj.name: error-not-color-only
reguloj.statement: An error of a kampo, a markobutono, an elekto, an elektilo or a tekstareo is not a red border alone: the Skemo carries a text slot error and speaks the state with aria-invalid.
reguloj.kialo: WCAG 1.4.1 (Use of Color) and 3.3.1 (Error Identification): a person who does not see the hue must read and hear that the field is wrong.
reguloj.scope: eroj: the Skemo of every Ero with the state invalid

reguloj.name: required-marked
reguloj.statement: A kampo, a markobutono, an elekto, an elektilo or a tekstareo with required true is marked visibly (part required-mark) and audibly (a11y text required in de and en).
reguloj.kialo: The person should know before sending what may stay empty. The sign of the mark is the Aspekto's; the duty to mark is not.
reguloj.scope: eroj: the Skemo of every Ero with a boolean prop required

reguloj.name: field-label-names-the-datum
reguloj.statement: The label of a kampo names what is entered, as a noun: 'E-Mail', not 'E-Mail eingeben'; the label of a sxaltilo names its setting the same way, the label of a markobutono its option, the label of an elekto, an elektilo or a tekstareo its question: 'Versandart', not 'Versandart wählen'.
reguloj.kialo: The label is read as the name of the field, in a form and in a list of fields; a verb in it reads as an instruction, not a name. A brand may show voice here, with a Jugxo.
reguloj.scope: eroj: kampo, sxaltilo, markobutono, elekto, elektilo and tekstareo instances with a label (check not-words: verbs of entering, of choosing for the elekto and the elektilo)

reguloj.name: help-is-one-sentence
reguloj.statement: The help text of a kampo, an elekto, an elektilo, a tekstareo or the reason field of a dialogo is one sentence.
reguloj.kialo: Help that is a paragraph is skipped; one sentence next to the field is read.
reguloj.scope: eroj: kampo, elekto, elektilo and tekstareo instances with a help text, and dialogo instances with a reason-help (check max-sentences 1)

reguloj.name: placeholder-is-example
reguloj.statement: The placeholder of a kampo is an example of a value: 'max@beispiel.example', not 'Hier E-Mail eingeben'.
reguloj.kialo: An example shows the shape of a value; an instruction in the field disappears while typing and is read as a value by some.
reguloj.scope: eroj: kampo instances with a placeholder (check not-words)

reguloj.name: switch-label-names-the-setting
reguloj.statement: The label of a sxaltilo names the setting as a state, 'Benachrichtigungen', not the action that changes it: 'Benachrichtigungen einschalten'.
reguloj.kialo: WAI-ARIA APG Switch pattern and WCAG 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value): the switch announces its state itself (on, off); a verb in its label announces it a second time and reads as a button, so a screen reader says 'Benachrichtigungen einschalten, Schalter, an' — the person cannot tell what is on.
reguloj.scope: eroj: sxaltilo instances with a label (check not-words: verbs of switching), an approximation without a model: 'Dark Mode an' (state word in the label) is not found

reguloj.name: option-labels-distinct
reguloj.statement: The options of an elekto or an elektilo and the tabs of a langetaro have distinct labels: two options never share a label.
reguloj.kialo: A choice is only possible between names a person can tell apart: two options called the same make the person guess which one counts, and a screen reader announces the same name twice in one group.
reguloj.scope: eroj: elekto and elektilo instances with option labels (slot options) and langetaro instances with their tabs (slot tabs, Spec 011 ⑤) (check distinct); compared without case and surrounding space, so 'Express' and 'express ' are one label; fixed, no Aspekto overrides it (Uzo content)

reguloj.name: elekto-options-few
reguloj.statement: An elekto shows at most five options; from the sixth on check_usage warns: the options belong in a list that opens on demand.
reguloj.kialo: From six visible options on nobody reads them all: the eye skims, the group grows to the height of a page, and a list that folds them away is quicker to use (GOV.UK: radios for a few options, a select for long lists). Three visible options read faster than any list.
reguloj.scope: eroj: elekto instances with options (slot options, check max-entries 5, a warning); adjustable: a brand may allow more with a Jugxo. Not checked: a horizontal elekto with four options or more (candidate, plan ③)

reguloj.name: select-placeholder-is-prompt
reguloj.statement: The placeholder of an elektilo is a prompt to choose, 'Bitte wählen', 'Land wählen': at least two words, never one of the options.
reguloj.kialo: The empty field of a select shows its placeholder where a chosen option will stand; a single word there reads as an option already chosen, and a person sends the form without choosing. A prompt says that nothing is chosen yet. Unlike the placeholder of a kampo it is no example of a value: the values are the options.
reguloj.scope: eroj: elektilo instances with a placeholder (check min-words 2), an approximation without a model: min-words only counts the words, so an option of two words ('Vereinigte Staaten') passes; adjustable: a brand may write its prompt otherwise with a Jugxo. The placeholder of the kampo stays an example (placeholder-is-example does not apply to the elektilo)

reguloj.name: dialog-title-names-the-decision
reguloj.statement: The title of a dialogo names the decision it asks for, 'Version freigeben?', 'Standard löschen?', never a word that only says that something is asked: 'Bestätigung', 'Achtung', 'Hinweis'.
reguloj.kialo: A dialog interrupts, and its title must say on its own what it is about: a screen reader names the dialog by its title when it opens, and a person who reads only the title decides from it.
reguloj.scope: eroj: dialogo instances (check not-words against a list of empty titles), an approximation without a model: the list names the usual empty words, a title like 'Wichtig' passes; adjustable: a brand may write its titles otherwise with a Jugxo

reguloj.name: badge-text-short
reguloj.statement: The label of an insigno has at most three words, 'In Prüfung', '3 Verstöße', never a sentence: 'Diese Version wird gerade geprüft'.
reguloj.kialo: A badge is skimmed next to what it describes, one glance; a sentence belongs in a notice (avizo), where it is read.
reguloj.scope: eroj: insigno instances (check max-words 3 on the label), an approximation without a model: it counts words, so three long words pass; adjustable: a brand may allow four with a Jugxo

reguloj.name: empty-state-says-what-next
reguloj.statement: The text of a plenstato with kind empty names what is missing and, where it can, the next step: 'Noch keine Standards. Lege den ersten an.', never 'Keine Treffer' alone.
reguloj.kialo: A person in front of an empty area asks what is missing and what to do; two words leave both open, a sentence answers at least the first.
reguloj.scope: eroj: plenstato instances with kind empty (check min-words 3 on the text), an approximation without a model: it counts words, so a long text without a next step passes; adjustable: a brand may write its empty states otherwise with a Jugxo

reguloj.name: table-caption-names-the-content
reguloj.statement: Every tabelo has a caption that says what stands in its rows, 'Standards', 'Prüfläufe der Version 3'; it may be hidden from sight, never missing.
reguloj.kialo: A screen reader names the table by its caption when the person enters it; without it the rows are numbers and words without a subject.
reguloj.scope: eroj: tabelo instances (check not-words against captions that name no content: 'Tabelle', 'Daten', 'Übersicht', 'Liste'; the Uzo makes the slot a duty), an approximation: the list names the usual empty captions, 'Dinge' passes; fixed: no brand writes tables without a caption that names its rows

reguloj.name: meter-text-states-value
reguloj.statement: The value text of a mezurilo names the value and what it refers to, '66 % von 3 prüfbaren', '3 von 5 geprüft'; an unknown value says so, 'nicht geprüft', never '0 %'.
reguloj.kialo: A bar without a number is colour alone, and 0 is a statement: a person who cannot see the fill, or who sees an empty bar, must read what it means.
reguloj.scope: eroj: mezurilo instances (check min-words 2 on the value text), an approximation without a model: '66 %' alone and '0 %' alone fail, 'nicht geprüft' passes; fixed

reguloj.name: icon-meaning-named
reguloj.statement: An icon that carries meaning has a name (label), and a button that shows only an icon has a label: 'Fehler', 'Warnung', 'Schließen' — never 'Icon' or 'Symbol', which name the picture and not what it means.
reguloj.kialo: A picture without a name is silent for a screen reader, and a name that only says 'icon' tells nothing; whoever cannot see the sign hears its meaning or hears nothing.
reguloj.scope: eroj: ikono instances with a status intent (info, success, warning, danger) carry a label (constraint of the Skemo, prop:label filled) and the label is judged on prop:label (check not-words: icon, image, symbol, glyph, picture / icon, symbol, bild, grafik, zeichen); butono instances that show only an icon carry a label (label-required judges it); fixed, no Aspekto overrides it (Uzo content)

reguloj.name: heading-levels-in-order
reguloj.statement: In a list of headings no level jumps down over a step: after a level 2 comes a 3, never a 4; going up (3 → 1) is allowed, it closes a section.
reguloj.kialo: The levels are the table of contents for a screen reader: a person jumps from heading to heading and hears the levels; a skipped level is a section that is not there.
reguloj.scope: eroj: titolo instances in a list, in their order (check levels-in-order on prop:level): a level more than one above its predecessor is a finding at that heading; fixed, no Aspekto overrides it (Uzo content)
